before_times: how much riding so far: never, a few times, or rides on their own (sets the lesson, the horse and whether a trail ride fits)
for boarding: the move-in date and the kind of horse
for flow B: a farm or a home, and the town; for a lesson, the customer's own horse and an arena or flat field
after_time: anything the instructor should know (a past fall, nerves around horses)
a favorite school horse, if there is one
secure_page_only: each rider's weight (the stable's limit for its horses), never in a text or through the AI
the waiver with the equine activity warning where the state's rules require it, signed by each rider (a parent signs for anyone under 18)
health notes that matter for riding (pregnancy, a recent surgery or concussion, seizures, a horse allergy)
for a horse brought in for a lesson on the customer's farm (flow B): the owner's own word on the horse's vaccines and Coggins test date, and any emergency vet OK the owner sets
for a pony party: the place's ground, and the number and ages of the children
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or legal guardian books for anyone under 18 and signs; for boarding, the horse's owner or someone the owner authorizes

stop.words: a rider fell and is hurt, a head injury, someone kicked or trapped under a horse, a loose horse on a road
stop.say: Call 911 now. Don't move someone who may have a neck or back injury. Stay clear of a loose horse.

go_on.words: a horse that's colicking, down, bleeding or badly lame (a boarder's own horse)
go_on.what: the stable's own line and the horse's vet first; Rosie gives no animal health advice
no riding (the stable's rule); a barn visit or a pony ride for a child can still be booked

go_on.words: a recent concussion, surgery or seizure
go_on.what: the booking waits for the instructor's private read; Rosie gives no medical advice

safety_and_stop_words.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Waiver with the equine activity warning
steps.when: signed on the secure page while booking
steps.who: every rider; a parent or guardian signs for anyone under 18; at a pony party, each child's own parent
steps.result: signed: it books; not signed: no riding until it's signed

steps.name: Rider's weight and level
steps.when: on the secure page while booking
steps.result: fits a horse: it books; over the limit or not ready: another service (a draft-horse lesson or a barn visit), before any money is taken

steps.name: Barn tour
steps.result: the owner then books the move-in

steps.name: Coggins test and vaccines
steps.when: on the secure page before a horse comes on the property, and kept current while it boards
steps.who: every horse that boards or hauls in
steps.goodFor: the Coggins test: 12 months, or as the state's rules set (a switch); vaccines: the barn's yearly list
steps.result: on file and in date: the horse may come; missing or ended: it doesn't come on the property

steps.name: Board agreement
steps.when: signed on the secure page before the move-in
steps.result: signed: the move-in books; its terms set the monthly board, extras, notice to end and emergency care

steps.name: Party place check (flow B)
steps.when: on the secure page while booking
steps.result: flat grass away from roads and pools: it books; otherwise the owner calls first

first_steps_and_forms.prep: wear long pants and boots or closed shoes with a heel; no loose jewelry; arrive 15 minutes early; eat and drink water first

staff.skills: beginner lessons, jumping, dressage, trail guide, pony handler, camp counselor, barn care for boarders
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each instructor's certificate and ratings are the stable's own word, shown to the owner; not checked by Rosie (D96)
staff.supervision: one guide for up to 6 trail riders; a second guide for any rider under 12 on the trail; camp keeps 1 adult for 6 campers (the stable's rule)
staff.who_oks: the head instructor OKs a rider's level for trails and jumping and reads health notes; the owner OKs fees, refunds and new boarders
staff.stand_in: another instructor who teaches that level may take a lesson, offered first, never assumed; a trail ride's guide may change, nothing moves for the riders

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or legal guardian books for anyone under 18 and signs; for boarding, the horse's owner or someone the owner authorizes
children_and_age.minors_texts: a minor's texts go to the parent or guardian

visit.check_in: at the barn office: the check-in code and the waiver on file; the guide ticks names for a trail ride or a camp day; at the customer's farm or home (flow B): the code at the gate
visit.done: the check-in code or the guide's roster, then DONE from the instructor
visit.changes_at_visit: a ride or lesson stopped for weather or a horse that goes lame: the rest moves to the indoor arena, another horse, or a new time, with no fee for the part not given
visit.before_work: every rider gets a fitted helmet; the instructor or guide checks boots, matches the horse, and checks the tack; the horse is checked sound before it works

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: none checked by Rosie: no state license to teach riding in most places; a stable registration or inspection is the owner's own word, where the state's rules ask for one (a switch from the state form)
license.who: the stable for its own registration or inspection; each instructor for their own certificate, if the owner shows one
license.ask: optional: the stable's registration number and any instructor certificate number the owner wants shown; nothing is checked
license.insurance: liability insurance is the stable's own matter; optional for the booking
license.background: any background check for staff is the owner's own step, outside Rosie

never_in_a_text: weight, health notes, a child's details and the horse's vet records never go in a text: only the secure page
